findingDetails.title: The Node-version fix pipes a downloaded script straight into bash, the pattern phase 015 removed from the Aside installer
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg for curl piped to bash or sh under .skilled/skills/mcp-browser-use excluding changelog and benchmark returns this one site; the Aside and Bladebro installers already verify digests

results.summary: D5 holds: operator stop-for-yes, pinned bladebro@4.8.2 with --ignore-scripts, and the npm uninstall rollback. Phase 015 D2 holds: the Aside installer runs only a digest-matching script.
Phase 015 criterion 2 Aside half holds: the capture example rejects any .. occurrence and then requires the ./tmp prefix. The advisor half is deferred.

noveltyJustification: Weighted new = 5 (P1) + 1 (P2) = 6. Weighted total = 6 new + 6 carried from iteration 1 = 12. Ratio 6/12 = 0.5. Both findings are new: neither the Node-18 fix nor the curl-pipe site was raised before.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: trust-boundary scripts and install instructions across three mode packets

targetSelection.selectionReason: The two phase 015 trust-boundary fixes plus every other install and download site in the hub, so the same defect class is checked fleet-wide rather than only where it was fixed
omittedHighRiskTargets: the three mode doctor.sh scripts (read only for the digest ordering claim)
the benchmark report transcripts (out of scope: recorded runs, not shipped instructions)
